record.question: Fiber Optics was invented by:
record.explanation: Answer C: Narinder Kapany. Narinder Singh Kapany is widely credited as a pioneer of fiber optics and coined the term. ‘Invented’ simplifies a field developed by multiple researchers, so the answer is the best listed choice rather than a claim of sole invention. Reference: https://www.optica.org/about/newsroom/obituaries/2020/narinder_s_kapany/; https://news.ucsc.edu/2020/12/narinder-kapany-in-memoriam/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
